title: Minimax-optimal Scaling Laws in Ridge Regression via Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23337v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained models are often reused across downstream tasks, motivating the question of whether this transfer learning procedure can provide a substantial performance improvement, namely, in terms of the scaling law. We address this question in the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression, where (i) a pretrained \emph{source} model is trained via ridge regression, and (ii) a fine-tuned \emph{target} model is regularized via the $L_2$ distance from the source estimator. First, we establish a deterministic equivalent for the risk of this two-step procedure under both model and covariance shift. Next, by specializing the deterministic equivalent to a shared regression function and commuting power-law covariance spectra, we identify a regime where the resulting scaling law achieves the minimax-optimal exponent. Notably, in this regime, the optimal source regularization depends on source data only, indicating its universality across

translated_title: 基于迁移学习的岭回归中的极小极大最优标度律
translated_abstract: 预训练模型常被跨下游任务复用，这引出一个自然的问题：这种迁移学习过程能否带来显著的性能提升，即体现在标度律方面。我们在高维回归的典型设定中研究这一问题：其中预训练的源模型通过岭回归训练，而微调后的目标模型通过与源估计器之间的 L2 距离进行正则化。首先，我们在同时存在模型偏移和协方差偏移的情形下，为该两步过程的风险建立了确定性等价表示。其次，通过将确定性等价特化到共享回归函数以及可交换的幂律协方差谱的情形，我们识别出一个区域，在该区域中所得到的标度律达到了极小极大最优指数。值得注意的是，在该区域中，最优的源正则化仅依赖于源数据，这表明其具有跨任务的普适性。
tldr: 本文在高维岭回归迁移学习框架下建立了风险确定性等价，并证明在共享回归函数和可交换幂律协方差谱的条件下可实现极小极大最优标度律，且最优源正则化仅依赖源数据、具有跨任务普适性。
